name: Acid Splash
description: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach character levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Aid
description: You bolster your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.

name: Alarm
description: Set an alarm on a door, window, or area in range no larger than a 20-foot cube. For 8 hours, it alerts you when a creature touches or enters the warded area. Choose creatures that do not trigger it and whether the alert is a handbell heard within 60 feet or a mental ping heard within 1 mile that can wake you.

name: Alter Self
description: You alter your physical form for up to 1 hour while you concentrate. Choose Aquatic Adaptation to breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed; Change Appearance to change your appearance without changing your statistics, size, or basic shape; or Natural Weapons to grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns, or hooves (Bludgeoning). Natural Weapons make your Unarmed Strike deal 1d6 damage of its type and use your spellcasting ability modifier for its attack and damage rolls instead of Strength. You can replace your chosen option with a different one as a Magic action.

name: Animal Friendship
description: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for 24 hours. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spell ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Animal Messenger
description: A Tiny Beast you can see within 30 feet attempts to deliver your message of up to 25 words to a recipient matching your general description at a location you have visited. A Beast with a Challenge Rating other than 0 succeeds automatically on its Charisma save and does not undertake the delivery; otherwise, a failed save sends it on its way. It travels about 25 miles per 24 hours, or 50 miles if it can fly. It delivers the message by mimicking you if it arrives before the spell ends; otherwise it returns to where you cast the spell and the message is lost. Each spell slot level above 2 adds 48 hours to the duration.

name: Animate Dead
description: Choose bones or a corpse of a Small or Medium Humanoid within range; it rises as a Skeleton or Zombie, respectively. For 24 hours, you can command any Undead you created with this spell as a Bonus Action while it is within 60 feet. If not commanded, it Dodges and moves only to avoid harm. When control ends, it stops obeying. Recasting can renew control over up to four Undead you made instead of animating a new one. A higher-level slot animates or renews control of two additional Undead per slot level above 3, each from a different body or pile of bones.
material: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust
